## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if applicable.

## Verification

List the relevant checks and results. For UI changes, include a screenshot. Distinguish mocked checks from live integrations and record any untested paths.

## Research impact

If numerical behavior, data, or scientific claims change, explain the source/graph identity, configuration, seeds, selection/evaluation protocol, and artifact/provenance consequences. Otherwise write “Not applicable.”
